package.name: amr_safety
package.description: SafetyGate: the low-latency safety override. A SERIAL gate and the last link before /cmd_vel, never a twist_mux input, so that a dead node stops the robot rather than letting commands through. Enforces d_safe = k*v^2 + d_min using measured velocity from odometry, with a per-robot payload-scaled k and hysteresis on release. C++ because it sits in the command path and its latency is measured. SKELETON: implemented in Phase 2.
